author: reek
body: Canonical, system-independent game entities, plus the system-neutral abstraction the rule-system emitters lower from. An entity's identity, appearance, and lore are invariant; only its stats render per system.

author: reek
body: The abstraction is a tagged union over entity kinds (weapon, character, ...), so one Entity type carries any kind and the emitters dispatch on the tag. Entities are authored in-source for the slice; DB-backing (entity / relationship / event tables, keyed to identity) is the generalization.

author: reek
body: granted-effects is a List Text (the html runtime has no text-split, so effects are a list, not a comma string).
